records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Maple Labs set up
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Account created first project day 1 and sent 1 invite, showing early momentum, but no activity or reply since the welcome email [email:f8f8ce47]; 6 days silent, no tickets, 8 days left. Some chance of self-serve progress, but the stall and Starter-plan solo usage suggest it's more likely than not to miss the window.

draft.subject: One next step for Maple Labs in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Nice work getting your first project created in Wrenfield and sending an invite out already. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next natural step is getting real work into that project with your teammate.

If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week to walk through that first step with you and answer anything that's come up. Just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Nadia
